description: The test clicks a button by the accessible name 'Sign in', but the login form's submit button is named 'Log in'. The app behaves correctly; the locator is wrong.

rootCause.summary: getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in' }) matches nothing; the page has a 'Log in' button, so the click waits until the test times out.

criteria.description: Names the locator's 'Sign in' button name
Says the locator does not match the element that exists

forbiddenClaims.description: Claims the app lacks a submit button
Claims the login page or backend is broken

requiredEvidence.why: Failure data must come from the MCP tools
The wrong button name is in the test source
The page snapshot shows a 'Log in' button

acceptable.description: Locate the button by its real name 'Log in'

forbidden.description: Raises timeouts or retries for a locator that never matches
